build_krisp_model: build a KRISP model instance with config to initialize VisualBERT and GraphNetworkModule for multimodal reasoning
forward_krisp_sample: run forward pass on a sample_list through the KRISP model to get combined VisualBERT and graph logits
build_visualbert_classification: build a VisualBERTForClassification module with BERT config and optional graph input embedding for VQA tasks
forward_visualbert_base: run forward pass through VisualBERTBase with text input_ids, attention_mask, and visual embeddings for joint encoding
forward_graph_ptr_net: run forward pass through GraphPtrNet to compute bilinear pointer scores between VisualBERT hidden states and graph nodes
